title: Matching and intersection problems for non-trivial $r$-partite $r$-uniform hypergraphs
summary: A central theme in extremal combinatorics is the study of the maximum number of edges in an $r$-uniform hypergraph ($r$-graph) with matching number at most $s$ (the Erdős Matching Conjecture) or with pairwise intersection at least $t$ (the $t$-intersection problem). The maximum sizes for these problems are typically achieved by trivial constructions: for the matching problem, the extremal construction consists of all edges intersecting a fixed set of $s$ vertices, while for the intersection problem, it consists of all edges containing a fixed set of $t$ vertices.
